caption: I budgeted R400 for eating out and spent R1 400. What's the line you always get wrong?

slides.title:
I budgeted my
R12 300 p/m.
Then I checked.
Living in Lydenburg
slides.body:
Male, 34
Single, no kids
Job: Self-employed tyre fitter at a roadside stand
Net income: R12 300 p/m (this month)

slides.title: Rent
slides.includes: Room with its own entrance, water included
slides.body: This is exactly what I budgeted. The only line that is.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.body: I forgot the bulk buy. I always forget the bulk buy.

slides.title: Black tax
slides.includes: My gran's groceries, my niece's school shoes
slides.body: I budgeted R1 000. I never budget black tax right, because it isn't mine to decide.

slides.title: Tools & stock
slides.includes: Patches, valves, a new compressor hose
slides.body: The compressor hose was a surprise. The business pays for itself a day at a time.

slides.title: Eating out & drinks
slides.includes: Friday lunches, weekend braai with friends
slides.body: I budgeted R400. I'm still not sure how this got to R1 400.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Airtime, funeral policy, stokvel, electricity, taxi fares, haircuts
slides.body: The funeral policy is R180 and the stokvel is R300. Those two I got right.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R12 300. On paper I planned to have about R3 300 left. I had R700.

slides.title: I stopped guessing
slides.body:
I uploaded my statement to Beyond Horizon and put my budget next to what I actually spent.

I had planned R400 for eating out.

No bank login needed.
